plotFile.title: Supplier plot file
plotFile.description: Upload a CSV, KML, KMZ or GeoJSON file from your supplier (or paste a direct download link). CSV needs latitude + longitude columns (one row per point, or several rows with the same plot ID for a polygon) or a WKT column. Comma or semicolon separated; decimal commas are fine.

plotFileUrls.title: More file links
plotFileUrls.description: Optional extra direct download links (CSV, KML/KMZ, GeoJSON). All files are merged into one package.

plotsText.title: Paste plots (CSV, KML or GeoJSON text)
plotsText.description: Optional: paste the file content instead of uploading. Handy from n8n, Make or Zapier.

geojson.title: GeoJSON plots (JSON)
geojson.description: Optional: a GeoJSON FeatureCollection, Feature or geometry. The prefilled demo is one 81 ha cattle plot in Rondonia (Brazil) with an open ring and supplier-style column names, so you can see the repairs, the screening and the PDF for one plot.

commodity.title: Commodity
commodity.description: Relevant commodity. Cattle allows point plots over 4 ha. Also used to suggest an HS heading if you leave it empty.

defaultCountry.title: Default country of production
defaultCountry.description: ISO 2-letter code (e.g. GH, CI, BR) or country name, used for plots without a country.

defaultProducerName.title: Default producer name
defaultProducerName.description: Used for plots without a producer name.

activityType.title: Activity type
activityType.description: DDS statement.activityType. Leave empty to fill it yourself.

hsHeading.title: HS heading
hsHeading.description: 2-10 digit HS code. Empty = a default suggested from the commodity, flagged for you to confirm.

netWeightKg.title: Net weight (kg)
netWeightKg.description: Mandatory in the DDS for IMPORT and EXPORT.

countryOfActivity.title: EU country of activity
countryOfActivity.description: ISO 2-letter code of the EU Member State.

internalReference.title: Your internal reference
internalReference.description: Optional internalReferenceNumber for the DDS draft.

geoLocationConfidential.title: Geolocation confidential
geoLocationConfidential.description: DDS geoLocationConfidential. Leave unset to decide later (it is listed in operatorMustFill).

runScreening.title: Screen for deforestation
runScreening.description: Check every plot against the JRC Global Forest Cover 2020 map and Hansen tree-cover loss 2021-2025. Free public data, no API key.

highRiskMinHa.title: High risk if forest-2020 lost after 2020 is at least (ha)
highRiskMinHa.description: Absolute threshold. Any smaller amount still gives "needs review".

highRiskPct.title: ...or at least this % of the plot

reviewForestPct.title: Needs review if forest in 2020 covers at least (%)
reviewForestPct.description: Plots that were largely forest in 2020 deserve a closer look even without detected loss (agroforestry and tree crops can map as forest).

generatePdf.title: Evidence PDF per plot
generatePdf.description: Write one evidence PDF per plot (map thumbnail, forest and loss numbers, fixes, sources). Turn off for a faster, smaller run.

makeZip.title: Also save everything as PACKAGE.zip
makeZip.description: Bundle the clean GeoJSON, DDS draft, fix log, summary and all PDFs into PACKAGE.zip.

removeDuplicates.title: Remove duplicate plots from the clean file
removeDuplicates.description: The EU system rejects duplicates. Off = keep and only warn.

sourceCrs.title: Source coordinate system (only for metres)
sourceCrs.description: Only if your file has coordinates in metres (e.g. UTM). Example: EPSG:32630. Leave empty for normal latitude/longitude.

maxPlotsPerFile.title: Max plots per GeoJSON file
maxPlotsPerFile.description: Clean output is split above this (EU: 1,000 producers per commodity line).

maxOutputFileMb.title: Max clean file size (MB)
maxOutputFileMb.description: Clean GeoJSON is split below the EU 25 MB limit.

maxPlots.title: Max plots to process
maxPlots.description: Hard cap on plots per run (cost control). Extra plots are skipped and not charged.

concurrency.title: Parallel workers
concurrency.description: Plots handled in parallel (PDFs and statistics).
